checked.claim: Daggerheart's roll window does not redraw when the roller's last Sanity is marked while it stands open, so it shows no Breakdown disadvantage and the GM's draw flags the roll.
checked.why: The module's half holds: the only redraw it asks for is updateActor with a module flag in the change, and a Sanity mark is system.resources (Breakdown follows as a status effect from syncOnce's toggleStatusEffect, not a flag; no preUpdateActor hook in resources/resource-guard/overflow/anonymity adds a drpg flag to a Sanity write). The GM's reader counts Breakdown at the draw and checkRoll pushes an advantage flag. But three things narrow it: (a) the window submits on every change of its form and each render runs forceConfig before _prepareContext, so any touch of the window by the player after the mark draws the Breakdown - only a player who presses Roll without touching anything meets it; (b) whether Daggerheart 2.12's own window rerenders on its actor's update is unread (the reader's own not_established); (c) the what_happens clause 'named to the roller' is wrong: rollerLine names only claims beyond the GM's sum in their own direction, and a source the GM counted that the window lacked is 'the GMs' to see, not the roller's'. The failure scenario (the GMs' whisper) survives.
evidence: scripts/roll-dialog.mjs:237 "if (isRollDialog(this)) forceConfig(this);" (every render, inside the wrapped _prepareContext)
audit/harness/lib/dh-dice/applications/dialogs/d20RollDialog.mjs:93 "submitOnChange: true," (the glue's copy of Daggerheart's form option, :32-36 of 2.12.8 as its header cites)
scripts/roll-draw.mjs:1618-1619 "a source the GM counted and the window lacked is the GMs' to see (`checkRoll`), not the roller's to be told of"

checked.claim: On a second GM's chat log the 'Rolls with no GM connected' card keeps Grant all / Grant none after the first GM decided; a press there does nothing and says nothing.
checked.why: decideNow updates only the roll messages (author and the granted stamp); the card is another message and nothing updates or rerenders it: grep of awayCard/awayRolls in scripts/ finds only the card's creation (roll-draw.mjs:2928-2929), this render hook and the GM-only flag list (private-rolls.mjs:1265); sheet-audit.mjs's awayCard is a different card. The 'open' test runs only at a render, so GM B's copy keeps its buttons until the log redraws. A press there removes them and askToDecide answers [] (awayRowOf is null for a stamp holding granted), and the hook ignores the answer: no notice. No double grant.

checked.claim: A roll thrown with no GM keeps the line 'a GM decides later' after it was granted or not.
checked.why: The line is inserted whenever the stamp flag is truthy; a decided stamp still holds the object with `granted`, so the rerender after decideNow's update draws the same line. No other branch reads `granted` for the line.

checked.claim: The Dynamic difficulty window's Refuse ('Turns the action down') refuses nothing when opened from the GMs' card: it answers null, read there as the editor closed.
checked.why: askDynamicDifficulty folds Refuse and a closed window into null; ruleSetDifficulty returns null on null, so wireCallActions re-enables the card's buttons (no held, no settled) and nothing reaches the player. The card's own Refuse (ruleRefuseDynamic) sends false. grep finds only the two callers (action-dynamic.mjs:100, messenger-app.mjs:876). The function's own docstring says null 'means no, you cannot do that' and the player is refused - a comment against code, which supports the finding. On a GM's own student the window's Refuse ends the action with no whisper, but that GM pressed it and nothing was paid, so the harm is the card road alone; minor holds.

checked.claim: Tail Someone reads its target list once; a target who left the room is refused by the GM only after the action is paid and both rolls thrown.
checked.why: tailTargets (othersInRoom) is read before the window; the pick is found in that list after the window and after traitFor's GM card; spendAction, the Shadow roll and the effect roll follow with no re-check of the room; the primary's startTail asks tailRefusal -> personActionRefusal, which answers 'the character is not in that room'; handleTailStart returns it as a refusal and performTail returns null with no abort. That a refusal after the roll keeps the price is a recorded rule elsewhere (action-listen.mjs's Shut comment: a refund after the roll would hand out its Hope), which is why Shut pre-checks what the browser knows before paying (shutShutWhy); Tail has no such pre-check. Minor holds.

checked.claim: No action window redraws while open: the briefing, the rows' shut reasons and the crisis turn are the first read.
checked.why: Action windows go actionWindow -> wideWindow -> drpgWindow with no `live` option; drpgWindow starts keepLive only when `live` is given. grep of keepLive/live:/Hooks.on/alreadyOpen in action-*.mjs, action-menus.mjs and ui-columns.mjs finds none. The presses read again before paying (watchShutWhy at performWatch:31, echoesShutWhy at performEchoes, crisisRefusal), so the cost is a press and a toast, except Tail (finding 6). Not under keepLive's focus wait (D-A1 does not apply); a stale window under the owner's rule: minor holds.
evidence: scripts/ui-columns.mjs:66 "return drpgWindow({ ...rest, width, body: columnsHtml(columns) });" (no live)

checked.claim: The rules manager never redraws: Save writes back every drawn row's text over another GM's rewording, and Withdraw withdraws whatever motive is in force.
checked.why: killingGameRules and motive go onChange -> onWorldChange -> sync.mjs SYNC.rules, which redraws ['sheets', 'hud'] only; rules.mjs has no hook or keepLive; drpgWindow is called without `live`. alreadyOpen is one per browser. Save's callback sends every drawn rule's field value (the open-time text unless edited) and saveRulesEdit maps today's list onto it, so a rewording saved by another GM in between is put back. Withdraw is setMotive(null) on what is in force.

checked.claim: A Reroll of an action a GM rules on posts a second card with Reply alone and leaves the first card's buttons live (suspected).
checked.why: Read further than the reader: settleGmRuling posts a new card with actions [reply] and touches no first card; replayRefusal does not hold back a described Search before the GM answered (only Observe while described, cleanup, Analyze of a bullet, crisis); the described Search's first card does carry 'Refuse the attempt' (declineAction, whose data carries paid: 'action' for the refund) and the ruled-miss button. Not read: whether the decline handler, at the press, reads the roll message or the Reroll's record and refuses a replaced roll, and whether a bookmark for a Search exists before the GM answers. It stays a question, not a finding.
evidence: scripts/reroll.mjs:1109 "if (ruledByHand(bookmark)) return await settleGmRuling(actor, bookmark, after, done);"

not_established: Finding 1: whether Daggerheart 2.12's roll window rerenders itself on its actor's update (its source is not in this checkout); if it does, forceConfig draws the Breakdown and the finding falls. Live check: open a student's roll window at Sanity 1 on a player, mark the last Sanity from the GM, read .disadvantage-chip.selected before touching the window.

Finding 10: what the described Search's, Observe's and Analyze's first-card buttons apply when pressed after a Reroll (the decline and ruled-miss handlers in messenger-app.mjs / call-gm.mjs not read to the end).

D-A1: no surface of this lane calls keepLive (grep of keepLive across scripts/ lists none of roll-dialog, roll-draw, reroll, action-*, rules, dice-look, messenger-app), so none is on the wait-for-focus rule; nothing here rises to major on D-A1.
